items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: We lived in the area between Howard Avenue and Canal, around in Drys and Ramport. Yeah. Girard.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. So once you moved to New Orleans, what neighborhood did you live in?
Did we live in then? We lived in the area between Howard Avenue and Canal, around in Drys and Ramport. Yeah. Girard.
Just right around the section. You were a downtown person.
